title: ranunculus glacialis f. crithmifolius
intro: Ranunculus glacialis f. crithmifolius, commonly known as Glacier Buttercup, is a plant species that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help in reducing pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Glacier Buttercup include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, which may be beneficial in treating conditions such as arthritis and muscle soreness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
